exposure: participation in educational activities on breastfeeding
cohort: The study included 13 incarcerated mothers who were breastfeeding their children in four prison units in Paraiba, Brazil.
finding: Only 2.6% of women under closed prison systems were breastfeeding in prison, and among these, exclusive breastfeeding was reported by the majority but for a maximum period of two months, with all infants using bottles and pacifiers from birth.
mod_finding: 76.9% of the mothers in the study cohort underwent cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from mothers currently breastfeeding in prison, with infants aged 1-5 months at the time of data collection.
